objective: Build safe exact-artifact inference with logical head semantics.
deliverable_refs: Model/head compatibility interface, safe-format allowlist and isolated loader.
Primary/optional head states, feature order checks, inference receipt.
Environment fingerprint and deterministic probe framework.
required_test_refs: Reject unsafe serialization, wrong feature order, invalid probability, oversized model and unsupported operators.
Unavailable optional heads stay typed and do not become zero.
acceptance_gate: Fixture artifacts load safely or fail explicitly and yield reproducible typed outputs.
